$comment: This repository lands its own pull requests with its own plugin. Start from config.example.json, which explains every key.
$comment_requiredChecks: The job in .github/workflows/test.yml that runs on every pull request.
$comment_requireApproval: The branch rules want one approving review. With a single maintainer, landing passes --admin.
$comment_releaseGuard: After every landing, the guard checks CHANGELOG.md on main still has the newest tag's heading.

hotspots.action: Rebase onto main and set the version by hand, one above main's.
hotspots.why: Two pull requests that raise the version to the same number merge cleanly into one version for two changes. The second landing then fails main's release job: a plugin file changed after the commit that set the version.

hotspots.action: Rebase onto main and re-add the entry by hand. Never let git resolve this file.
hotspots.why: Two pull requests inserting under the same heading merge cleanly and silently drop one of the entries.
